decisions.reason: The repair branch conditionally calls for complete outer tie-rod ends when worn, while Cardone 22-K300 is only a tie-rod-end bushing kit and cannot replace the prescribed assemblies.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Transfer or replace the outer tie-rod ends if worn after replacing the leaking steering rack, then align the front end.
reviewedSourceEvidence.catalog: ShowMeTheParts lists Cardone 22-K300 as a Steering Tie Rod End Bushing Kit for 1999-2004 Chrysler 300M applications, not as complete outer tie-rod ends.
reviewedSourceEvidence.directLink: No exact product link was resolved, and exact identity would not cure the wrong repair role.
